description: Rich Markdown preview (Mermaid diagrams, math, highlighted code, heading outline, Ctrl+F) in the Windows Explorer preview pane. Per-user, no admin, fully offline.
post_install: Write-Host 'Registering the Markdown preview handler (per-user, no admin)...'
notes: In Explorer press Alt+P to show the preview pane, then select a .md file.
The first preview seeds a cache (~15 s, off-screen); after that it is fast.
Remote images are off by default. To toggle, run set-remote-images.ps1 -On (or -Off) from the app folder.
Requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime; it ships with Windows 11 and most Windows 10, and is installed per-user automatically if missing.
